Fixed. The change is a single edit in markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go:258 — the `gitHubAlertRe` regex now uses the `(?i)` flag so `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, `[!nOtE]`, etc. are recognized as GitHub alerts (the matched type was already lowercased via `strings.ToLower`).

Validation:
- `go test ./markup/goldmark/blockquotes/...` passes, including `TestBlockquoteHook` which asserts `[!nOtE]` renders as an alert (issue 12767 case).
- All `./markup/...` tests pass. The `hugolib` package test failure is pre-existing and environmental (no network to fetch `leaktest` dependency), confirmed identical on the unmodified tree.
